name: LoveAI Persona Evaluation Matrix
description: 34-question psychological matrix (17 dimensions x 2 items, balanced keying). Likert 1-5. Reverse = agreement lowers the trait score. Canonical TS source: server/src/persona/matrix.ts (mirrored here for the ML pipeline).

questions.text: I enjoy exploring new ideas, even ones that challenge my beliefs.
I prefer routines and familiar ways of doing things.
I follow through on tasks even when they are tedious.
I often leave things half-finished or put them off to the last minute.
I feel energized by meeting new people.
I tend to be quiet and reserved around new people.
I go out of my way to help people who need it.
I sometimes come across as cold or indifferent to others.
I worry about things long after they are over.
I stay calm and even-tempered under stress.
I usually know why I feel the way I do.
My own emotions often take me by surprise.
When I get upset, I can calm myself down quickly.
My temper gets the better of me under pressure.
I can sense how people around me are feeling even before they say it.
I am not easily moved by other people’s moods.
I find it easy to make people feel comfortable around me.
I struggle to get others to see my point of view.
I can say “no” without feeling guilty about it.
I tend to give in to avoid conflict, even when I disagree.
When someone is talking, I give them my full attention and don’t interrupt.
I often start planning my reply while the other person is still speaking.
I’d rather have a long text conversation than a phone call.
I prefer talking out loud (voice or video) to typing.
In a disagreement, I prefer to address the issue directly and work it out together.
When there is tension, I’d rather avoid the topic and let it pass.
I do my best work when the task itself genuinely interests me.
I only really push myself when there is an external payoff (reward, praise, deadline).
Recognition, praise, and tangible rewards strongly motivate me.
Status, titles, and material rewards matter little to me.
It is important to me to act with integrity, even when it causes friction.
It is more important to me that my life stays stable and predictable than that I push for change.
I want my life to be full of new experiences and adventures.
I measure success by concrete achievements and milestones, not by new experiences.

vector.description: 17-dim normalized profile centered at 0.5, projected with a seeded Gaussian matrix (mulberry32 + Box-Muller) into 768 dims, L2-normalized. Cosine similarity in pgvector then reflects trait proximity. TS implementation: server/src/persona/vector.ts.
